en: Conditioned by a state that is not associated with mind (nacitta), a state not associated with mind arises by way of root condition.

Conditioned by a state not associated with mind, a state not dissociated from mind (nanocitta) arises by way of root condition. Conditioned by a state not associated with mind, states both not associated with mind and not dissociated from mind arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is not mind, a state that is not mind arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on states that are both not mind and not non-mind, a state that is not mind arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are five; ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are five. (In all cases there are five.)
